world-cup-2026.subtitle: Make your picks. Submit to a pool. See how you do!
world-cup-2026.playsHint: This World Cup 2026 has 2 stages: <bold>Groups</bold> & the <bold>Bracket</bold>

about.groupsP1: Predict the precise final ranking (1st–4th) for all 48 teams in their respective groups. You gain 1 point for each position placed correctly.
about.groupsP2: Achieving a perfect 48/48 record awards a crucial +2 point bonus, for a maximum possible 50-point bank.
about.groupsP3: Points banked here act as a strategic currency for future swaps during the Bracket Stage.
about.bracketP1: A clean, fresh bracket is provided after the Group stage is complete so you can predict all winners from the Round of 32 through to the Champion.
about.bracketP2: This knockout structure is standard elimination, but with a unique twist. Depending on your results from the Group phase, you will have the ability to course-correct when needed!
about.bracketP3: Points increase in value each subsequent round: 2 – 4 – 8 – 16 – 32, ensuring a dramatic and competitive finish.
about.swapP1: In the event that one of your predictions is eliminated, you can activate your accumulated Group points to modify the path they were projected to win.
about.swapP2: How it works: You aren't fixing the past (Round of 32 or Round of 16); you are buying a replacement guess for that team's future matches (Quarter-finals and onward).
about.swapP3: Swaps only correct the path moving forward. They do not award missing points retrospectively.
about.swapP4: The cost to make a swap increases in a strict Fibonacci sequence, making each subsequent correction exponentially more expensive: 3, 5, 8, 13, 21.
